Name: Ghostlier Mariner
Author: inmognito
Description:
Uses [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3853]Content Patcher Animations[/url] to create an animated ghostly version of the Mariner.

Should be compatible with most other mods unless they also replace the mariner.
[list]
[*]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]﻿, it will draw the animated mariner over the Seasonal Outfits one.  It's not the worst, but it doesn't give the intended effect.
[*]Seems to work okay wwith [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10758]Maritime Secrets[/url]﻿.
[/list]
